QuestInfo.name: [12th Anniversary] Maple Rain
QuestInfo.0: It's raining Maple Leaves in Henesys and Leafre for the 12th Anniversary! Talk to Cassandra to hear the details.
QuestInfo.1: It's raining Maple Leaves in Henesys and Leafre for the 12th Anniversary! Talk to Cassandra to hear the details.
QuestInfo.2: Gather up the 12th Anniversary Maple Leaves falling in Henesys and Leafre at the 13 minute mark of each hour, from 10:00 to 22:00.\r\nDonate enough to the town of your choice and receive a special gift!
